messages:
Priya (Finance): Heads-up: launching a billing policy update affecting short bursts, invoice timing, and free-credit tapering. Please don't externalize until we publish comms next week.

Luca (Billing): Summary: 1) One 24-hour "burst buffer" per 7-day rolling window auto-applied; 2) sustained alignment fee after 7 consecutive days above 50% reserved or 2x baseline; 3) invoices finalize on the 3rd business day to allow batching and clearer line items.

Nate (Product): Any SDK/rate-limit changes? How will we surface this in the dashboard?

Priya (Finance): No rate-limit changes. Dashboard will show a soft banner at 70% quota and a new "billing hints" tooltip that links to docs. Invoices will include line items: BURST_BUFFER_CREDIT and SUSTAINED_ALIGNMENT_FEE with short notes.

Ava (Support): Will credits be applied automatically? Need AE templates and dispute flow.

Luca (Billing): Burst buffer credits auto-apply. Sustained alignment fees trigger a notification and a 10-day dispute window; disputes route to billing-ops for manual review within 5 business days. Playbook + sample emails to be posted to #support-channels tomorrow.

BillingBot: Free-credit taper note: accounts breaching sustained thresholds will see prorated credit reductions starting 2026-06-01 with 30-day notice. Rule id: FC-TAPER-26.

Priya (Finance): Rollout plan: internal docs 2026-04-10, targeted notices 2026-04-20, public FAQ + blog 2026-04-30, enforcement for burst buffer 2026-05-01 and credit taper 2026-06-01. Exceptions for negotiated enterprise terms and flagged pilots.

Nate (Product): Ops action items?

Priya (Finance): Add soft-cap banner, build an internal /quota-audit endpoint, and include a chargeback_tag in billing CSVs. Ops/Product to coordinate this week.

Ava (Support): Thanks — will prep AE scripts once playbook is live. Priya: please cc me on the early notices list.
